title: Notifications
intro: Get a heads-up when your monthly summary is ready and, if you like, an evening nudge on days you logged nothing.
iosHint: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work in the installed app: add monkimoney to your Home Screen and open it from there.
enableFailed: Notifications could not be turned on. Try again.
unsupportedIos: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work in the installed app. Add monkimoney to your Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen), open it from there and come back here.
unavailable: Notifications are not available right now.
denied: Notifications are blocked for monkimoney. Allow them in your browser or device settings, then come back here.
summaryHint: On the 1st, once last month’s summary is written.
reminderHint: Only on days you have not logged anything.
